images.note: Panel label inside figure: Sz 73. R68 = 5.71 au (0.0365"); including the faint outer rings R68 = 28.6 au (0.183"). Substructure detected: inner plateau-type gap/ring pair D4 at 3.5 au and B6 at 5.5 au (from the frank profile, not visible by eye in the CLEAN image), plus faint outer gap/ring pairs B33 (33 au) and B47 (47 au) - outer rings contribute 8.6 mJy, 40% of the total flux. Brightest disk in the sample. Beam 18x14 mas = 2.8x2.2 au, PA_b = 26 deg; F_nu = 21.43 +/- 1.49 mJy; rms 36 uJy/beam. EB 21 Jul 2025.
